notes: Version-pair-scoped migrations. There is deliberately no global alias table: the token CP is re-bound between smb-v1-draft and smb-v2-consensus, so a flat alias dictionary would silently corrupt data. Each entry maps tokens for human-readable notation only; stored data keys on (vocab_version, concept_id) and migration of a reading is performed on concept ids.

evidence: Verbatim definition-text identity: the smb-v1-draft CP definition 'Defined molecular components, building blocks, or modifications are proposed, but their positions, connectivities, or arrangements remain unresolved.' is the smb-v2-consensus SC definition, so CP(component) -> SC.

Verbatim definition-text identity: the smb-v1-draft MO definition 'A diagnostic substructure or structural motif is proposed, but a component-level representation is not sufficiently defined.' is the smb-v2-consensus SI definition, so MO -> SI.
Verbatim definition-text identity: the smb-v1-draft CL definition is the smb-v2-consensus CP 'Class proposed' definition, so CL -> CP and the token CP is reused for a different concept.

Definition-text identity for evidence: the smb-v1-draft CX row and the smb-v2-consensus CO row carry the same contextual-evidence meaning, and the intermediate Shin_MassBank_Annotation_Metadata_Proposal_EN.docx section 4 printed the row as 'CX or CO?', showing the rename was in progress.

User confirmation, Hiroshi Tsugawa, 2026-09-03: sections 1-4 of Shin_MassBank_Annotation_Metadata_Proposal_EN_V2.docx are the internationally agreed consensus, which fixes the direction of the migration as smb-v1-draft -> smb-v2-consensus.
migrations.review_notes: Not yet reviewed in a workshop session. reused_tokens and dropped_terms are the two facts a reviewer must confirm first.

evidence: Strict extension: smb-v2.1-proposal carries every smb-v2-consensus term unchanged and adds one term, SM, so every consensus concept maps to itself and no token changes meaning.
migrations.review_notes: The addition of SM itself is the open question; the mapping is trivially identity.

evidence: Reverse of the extension. smb:evidence/model_spectral_similarity does not exist in the consensus set, so a reading carrying it loses that tag and is marked unresolved rather than being silently recoded as SL or IS.
migrations.review_notes: Confirms that downgrading to the consensus set is lossy and says so, instead of guessing a substitute tag.
